The y-axis units are not given as “篇” (papers/articles), even though the reference specifies this.

The description says the chart is stacked, but it does not mention the full legend-color correspondence for all ten institutions as laid out in the reference, nor that the x-axis is a linear time sequence from 1994 to 2023.
